verification.repairs: Initial Core fixture assertions failed because APFS aliases loose canonical-equivalent ref filenames and because the source token filter retains its post-quote prefix behavior; packed refs and source-correct expectations fixed them. Initial Debug Collection conversion fixed with Array. First native popup assertion incorrectly expected representedObject; corrected indexed/title check then exposed a real AppKit addItems title collapse. Isolated diagnostic shows bulk insertion merges NFC/NFD titles, direct NSMenuItem insertion preserves them; shared popup now uses direct insertion. Final focus assertion tightened to exclude nil-identity false positives and passes both engines. Failed and diagnostic logs retained locally.
